paper.title_en: Boson Stars with Ayón--Beato--García nonlinear electrodynamics
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we study spherically symmetric boson star solutions in Einstein gravity minimally coupled to Ayón--Beato--García nonlinear electrodynamics and a massive complex scalar field. We find that these solutions exist only when the electric charge $q$ is below a critical value. Within this range, solutions with relatively small charges can exhibit a gravitational blueshift, and the radial mass function becomes negative in some regions while the ADM mass remains positive. For larger charges, frozen boson-star solutions emerge as the scalar-field frequency $ω$ approaches zero. In these configurations, the metric function $1/g_{rr}$ and $-g_{tt}$ become very small near a special position $r_{\mathrm{ch}}$, and the spacetime resembles an extremal black hole from the perspective of an observer at infinity. Moreover, timelike trajectories in these frozen boson stars are strongly deflected near $r_{\mathrm{ch}}$, and particles require a longer coordinate time to traverse the same radial distance than they do in ordinary boson stars.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了爱因斯坦引力最小耦合Ayón-Beato-García非线性电动力学与有质量复标量场时的球对称玻色星解，涉及引力场方程求解、ADM质量、度规函数行为等广义相对论基础与自引力系统结构问题，并给出临界电荷、冻结解和类极端黑洞行为等具体结果，具备一定理论深度与可读性，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带有Ayón–Beato–García非线性电动力学的玻色星
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了爱因斯坦引力最小耦合到Ayón–Beato–García非线性电动力学以及一个有质量复标量场时的球对称玻色星解。我们发现这些解仅当电荷$q$低于某一临界值时才存在。在该范围内，电荷相对较小的解可以表现出引力蓝移，并且径向质量函数在某些区域变为负值，而ADM质量保持为正。对于更大的电荷，当标量场频率$ω$趋于零时会出现冻结的玻色星解。在这些位形中，度规函数$1/g_{rr}$和$-g_{tt}$在特殊位置$r_{\mathrm{ch}}$附近变得非常小，且从无穷远观测者的视角看时空类似于极端黑洞。此外，这些冻结玻色星中的类时轨迹在$r_{\mathrm{ch}}$附近被强烈偏折，粒子穿越相同径向距离所需的坐标时间比在普通玻色星中更长。
